notes: Upgrade materials use the values at least two of three sources agree on; materials null = sources disagreed.
Great Fairy upgrades cost no rupees, only materials (rupees: 0).
Per-level defense follows the standard ladder for each base defense; null where sources conflict.
setBonus needs every piece of the set worn; requiresLevel 2 means each piece must be upgraded at least twice.

greatFairies.note: The rupee price depends on how many fountains you have already opened, not on which fairy it is. Each fairy you free raises the highest upgrade level available at every fountain by one.
